chapter.title: Conclusion
chapter.subtitle: Five answers, and what they do not say
chapter.sub: Chapter eleven: conclusion. Let's answer the five questions and see what this study does and does not say.
chapter.tts: Chapter eleven, conclusion. Let's answer the five questions and see what this study does and does not say.

lines.sub: Here they are: five questions, five answers.
lines.tts: Here they are. Five questions, five answers.

lines.sub: Along the top, the key pictures of this video have come back as small tiles.
lines.tts: Along the top, the key pictures of this video have come back as small tiles.

lines.sub: Each question is paired with the objective of the same number.
lines.tts: Each question is paired with the objective of the same number.

lines.sub: Question one: do the two scores order contracts differently? Yes.
lines.tts: Question one. Do the two scores order contracts differently? Yes.

lines.sub: Kendall's τ is 0.174, neither 0 nor 1.
lines.tts: Kendall's tau is zero point one seven four, neither zero nor one.

lines.sub: So EndorseRank and AWP order the same contracts quite differently.
lines.tts: So EndorseRank and A W P order the same contracts quite differently.

lines.sub: But the two scores walk different graphs in different ways, so to some degree this follows by construction.
lines.tts: But the two scores walk different graphs in different ways, so to some degree this follows by construction.

lines.sub: Question two: what does each score agree with?
lines.tts: Question two. What does each score agree with?

lines.sub: Each score agrees most with the proxies built from its own edges.
lines.tts: Each score agrees most with the proxies built from its own edges.

lines.sub: EndorseRank reaches 0.585 with the allowance proxies, and AWP 0.572 with the transfer proxies.
lines.tts: EndorseRank reaches zero point five eight five with the allowance proxies, and A W P zero point five seven two with the transfer proxies.

lines.sub: This is an intended-construct check.
lines.tts: This is an intended-construct check.

lines.sub: The proxies come from the same records, so part of the agreement is built in.
lines.tts: The proxies come from the same records, so part of the agreement is built in.

lines.sub: Question three: how long does each take? Time follows the number of edges.
lines.tts: Question three. How long does each take? Time follows the number of edges.

lines.sub: AWP took 2.17 times as long as EndorseRank, and its graph has 2.23 times as many edges.
lines.tts: A W P took two point one seven times as long as EndorseRank, and its graph has two point two three times as many edges.

lines.sub: It is the same solver, so the speed comes from the graph.
lines.tts: It is the same solver, so the speed comes from the graph.

lines.sub: Question four: do the scores predict later events, and better than the count?
lines.tts: Question four. Do the scores predict later events, and better than the count?

lines.sub: Every score predicted later events to some degree.
lines.tts: Every score predicted later events to some degree.

lines.sub: On the transfer side, the walk, that is AWP, beat the plain count.
lines.tts: On the transfer side, the walk, that is A W P, beat the plain count.

lines.sub: But on the allowance side, the plain count beat EndorseRank, the score I proposed.
lines.tts: But on the allowance side, the plain count beat EndorseRank, the score I proposed.

lines.sub: These are post hoc comparisons, made after seeing the labels.
lines.tts: These are post hoc comparisons, made after seeing the labels.

lines.sub: Question five: does mixing both edge types help? No.
lines.tts: Question five. Does mixing both edge types help? No.

lines.sub: C-PR, which mixes the two edge types, met neither of the two rules fixed in advance, A and B.
lines.tts: C P R, which mixes the two edge types, met neither of the two rules fixed in advance, rule A and rule B.

lines.sub: This is a re-analysis that applies the rules to the revised scores.
lines.tts: This is a re-analysis that applies the rules to the revised scores.

lines.sub: And the registered analysis gave the same verdicts.
lines.tts: And the registered analysis gave the same verdicts.

lines.sub: The line at the bottom is about an outcome found in neither edge type, such as avoiding liquidation.
lines.tts: The line at the bottom is about an outcome found in neither edge type, such as avoiding liquidation.

lines.sub: There, we found no evidence that the allowance side leads.
lines.tts: There, we found no evidence that the allowance side leads.

lines.sub: And the comparison between the PageRank versions was not resolved.
lines.tts: And the comparison between the PageRank versions was not resolved.

lines.sub: Again, this is a re-analysis on the revised scores.
lines.tts: Again, this is a re-analysis on the revised scores.

lines.sub: Now the row of objectives: the first three were met.
lines.tts: Now the row of objectives. The first three were met.

lines.sub: But all three were met largely by construction.
lines.tts: But all three were met largely by construction.

lines.sub: The fourth was only partly met: prediction was met, but only AWP did better than the count.
lines.tts: The fourth was only partly met. Prediction was met, but only A W P did better than the count.

lines.sub: The fifth was not met, and the same holds in the registered analysis.
lines.tts: The fifth was not met, and the same holds in the registered analysis.

lines.sub: So what does this study add? Five things.
lines.tts: So what does this study add? Five things.

lines.sub: Let's take them one card at a time.
lines.tts: Let's take them one card at a time.

lines.sub: First, it uses the allowance as an edge of contract reputation. That is EndorseRank.
lines.tts: First, it uses the allowance as an edge of contract reputation. That is EndorseRank.

lines.sub: The allowance an owner gives a contract is an endorsement.
lines.tts: The allowance an owner gives a contract is an endorsement.

lines.sub: Second, an evaluation design that sets every score against the raw count before smoothing, in the same window and in two windows outside it.
lines.tts: Second, an evaluation design that sets every score against the raw count before smoothing, in the same window and in two windows outside it.

lines.sub: Third, a closed form that shows what EndorseRank actually computes at a depth-one spender.
lines.tts: Third, a closed form that shows what EndorseRank actually computes at a depth-one spender.

lines.sub: There, EndorseRank is a split approval count.
lines.tts: There, EndorseRank is a split approval count.

lines.sub: Fourth, C-PR, which mixes the two edge types, tested by rules fixed in advance. It met neither rule, A nor B.
lines.tts: Fourth, C P R, which mixes the two edge types, tested by rules fixed in advance. It met neither rule A nor rule B.

lines.sub: Fifth, a comparison registered in advance on an outcome found in neither edge type.
lines.tts: Fifth, a comparison registered in advance on an outcome found in neither edge type.

lines.sub: In this study, that outcome is liquidation avoidance among GMX V2 contract traders.
lines.tts: In this study, that outcome is liquidation avoidance among G M X V two contract traders.

lines.sub: The PageRank algorithm and AWP's weights are borrowed.
lines.tts: The PageRank algorithm and A W P's weights are borrowed.

lines.sub: What is new is the allowance as a kind of edge, and the way it was tested.
lines.tts: What is new is the allowance as a kind of edge, and the way it was tested.

lines.sub: Let me also be clear about the limitations.
lines.tts: Let me also be clear about the limitations.

lines.sub: This is what this study does not say.
lines.tts: This is what this study does not say.

lines.sub: First, these scores use no off-chain information except daily prices and the token list.
lines.tts: First, these scores use no off-chain information except daily prices and the token list.

lines.sub: Off-chain means anything not recorded on the chain itself.
lines.tts: Off-chain means anything not recorded on the chain itself.

lines.sub: So we cannot tell whether the owners who approve a contract are really different people.
lines.tts: So we cannot tell whether the owners who approve a contract are really different people.

lines.sub: It is only a reputation of contracts. It says nothing about whether the code is safe.
lines.tts: It is only a reputation of contracts. It says nothing about whether the code is safe.

lines.sub: Only contracts received scores, so it says nothing at all about ordinary EOA addresses.
lines.tts: Only contracts received scores, so it says nothing at all about ordinary E O A addresses.

lines.sub: And the revised analysis in the main text was set after the registered results were known, so its verdicts are a re-analysis.
lines.tts: And the revised analysis in the main text was set after the registered results were known, so its verdicts are a re-analysis.

lines.sub: The comparisons with the raw count, and with the variant that restarts more often at active owners, were made after seeing the labels.
lines.tts: The comparisons with the raw count, and with the variant that restarts more often at active owners, were made after seeing the labels.

lines.sub: So they are post hoc.
lines.tts: So they are post hoc.

lines.sub: And the results come from an ego network that keeps only the edges touching the cohort.
lines.tts: And the results come from an ego network that keeps only the edges touching the cohort.

card.title: Ego network
card.body: Only the edges that touch the cohort's contracts, not the whole chain

lines.sub: They come from five tokens, from one chain, Arbitrum One, and from these months only.
lines.tts: They come from five tokens, from one chain, Arbitrum One, and from these months only.

lines.sub: The trader samples are small: 70 in W1 and 88 in W0.
lines.tts: The trader samples are small. Seventy in W one and eighty-eight in W zero.

lines.sub: And the score with uniform restarts is weak against closed farms.
lines.tts: And the score with uniform restarts is weak against closed farms.

lines.sub: Remember the wallet window from the very beginning of this video?
lines.tts: Remember the wallet window from the very beginning of this video?

lines.sub: Given what we found, what could that window show?
lines.tts: Given what we found, what could that window show?

lines.sub: The window from the start opens again.
lines.tts: The window from the start opens again.

lines.sub: This time it has one more line: the number of distinct owner addresses that approved this contract.
lines.tts: This time it has one more line. The number of distinct owner addresses that approved this contract.

lines.sub: Owners here are addresses, so the line counts addresses, not people.
lines.tts: Owners here are addresses, so the line counts addresses, not people.

lines.sub: Going by this study's results, this number is a public signal that any service can compute without PageRank.
lines.tts: Going by this study's results, this number is a public signal that any service can compute without PageRank.

lines.sub: And in the out-of-window test, EndorseRank did not beat it either.
lines.tts: And in the out-of-window test, EndorseRank did not beat it either.

lines.sub: The N on the screen is a placeholder and does not point to any particular contract.
lines.tts: The N on the screen is a placeholder and does not point to any particular contract.

lines.sub: But this number only says how widely the contract is approved.
lines.tts: But this number only says how widely the contract is approved.

lines.sub: A low number is a reason to look closer.
lines.tts: A low number is a reason to look closer.

lines.sub: But a high number is no reason to sign.
lines.tts: But a high number is no reason to sign.

lines.sub: That is why the cursor only rests on the Approve button.
lines.tts: That is why the cursor only rests on the Approve button.

lines.sub: For further research, I have four things in mind.
lines.tts: For further research, I have four things in mind.

lines.sub: First, register the activity-restart variant in advance on a new window and test it against the count.
lines.tts: First, register the activity-restart variant in advance on a new window and test it against the count.

lines.sub: For now, this is only a hypothesis.
lines.tts: For now, this is only a hypothesis.

lines.sub: Second, redo the revised analysis itself as a registered test.
lines.tts: Second, redo the revised analysis itself as a registered test.

lines.sub: Third, restart only from trusted seeds, to block farms.
lines.tts: Third, restart only from trusted seeds, to block farms.

card.title: Trusted seeds
card.body: Chosen addresses that the walk restarts from, instead of every node

lines.sub: Under uniform restarts, a closed farm still collects a share.
lines.tts: Under uniform restarts, a closed farm still collects a share.

lines.sub: And fourth, compare the scores with real contract-risk labels, such as drainers, which empty wallets, and rug pulls, where the makers run off with the money.
lines.tts: And fourth, compare the scores with real contract-risk labels, such as drainers, which empty wallets, and rug pulls, where the makers run off with the money.

lines.sub: The four nodes of our small world rise again, like a constellation.
lines.tts: The four nodes of our small world rise again, like a constellation.

lines.sub: It is the small world where we first built PageRank from scratch.
lines.tts: It is the small world where we first built PageRank from scratch.

lines.sub: Thank you for watching.
lines.tts: Thank you for watching.

lines.sub: At a live talk, this is where questions would come in.
lines.tts: At a live talk, this is where questions would come in.

lines.sub: If you have one, please leave it in the comments.
lines.tts: If you have one, please leave it in the comments.

lines.sub: I thank my supervisors, Professor Mnkandla, Professor Moulla and Dr. Attipoe.
lines.tts: I thank my supervisors, Professor Mnkandla, Professor Moulla and Doctor Attipoe.

lines.sub: The code and all the results of this study are in the public repository.
lines.tts: The code and all the results of this study are in the public repository.

lines.sub: And for every number in this video, I have noted which value in which file it comes from.
lines.tts: And for every number in this video, I have noted which value in which file it comes from.

outro.sub: That brings us to the end of this walk through my thesis.
outro.tts: That brings us to the end of this walk through my thesis.

outro.sub: We saw how an allowance can become an edge of reputation, how the scores were tested, and where the plain count still wins.
outro.tts: We saw how an allowance can become an edge of reputation, how the scores were tested, and where the plain count still wins.

outro.sub: Next time a wallet asks for your approval, I hope you will remember what that one click records.
outro.tts: Next time a wallet asks for your approval, I hope you will remember what that one click records.
